title: Peek — Accounts and parcels
description: Accounts, their activity and the parcels they track, from the app database's metrics schema. Days are UTC. See docs/OBSERVABILITY.md.

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts now.

targets.rawSql: select accounts from metrics.live

panels.title: New, 7 days
panels.description: Accounts made in the last seven UTC days, today included.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(sum(accounts_created), 0) from metrics.daily
where day > (now() at time zone 'UTC')::date - 7

panels.title: Active accounts
panels.description: Accounts that opened their deliveries, on the web or the iPhone in the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days.

targets.rawSql:
select active_day as "24 h", active_week as "7 days", active_month as "30 days"
from metrics.live

panels.title: Tracking now
panels.description: Parcels neither delivered, returned nor archived, with or without an account.

targets.rawSql: select parcels_open_account + parcels_open_lookup from metrics.live

panels.title: Added, 24 h
panels.description: Parcels added to an account or looked up without one in the last 24 hours.

targets.rawSql: select parcels_added_account + parcels_added_lookup from metrics.live

panels.title: All parcels
panels.description: Every parcel added to an account or looked up without one. Days from before the counts were kept miss the parcels deleted since.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(parcels_added_account + parcels_added_lookup), 0) from metrics.daily

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts at the end of each UTC day. Days from before the counts were kept miss the accounts deleted since.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, accounts as "Accounts"
from metrics.daily
where accounts is not null and $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: New accounts per day
panels.description: Accounts made each UTC day.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, accounts_created as "New accounts"
from metrics.daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Active accounts per day
panels.description: Accounts that opened their deliveries, on the web or the iPhone each UTC day. Earlier periods count sign-ins and session renewals instead, from before openings were recorded.

targets.rawSql:
select (starts::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, accounts as "Active accounts"
from metrics.active_accounts
where period = 'day'
  and starts >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone 'UTC')::date
  and starts <= $__timeTo()::date
order by 1

panels.title: Active accounts per week
panels.description: Accounts that opened their deliveries, on the web or the iPhone each UTC week (from Monday). Earlier periods count sign-ins and session renewals instead, from before openings were recorded.

targets.rawSql:
select (starts::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, accounts as "Active accounts"
from metrics.active_accounts
where period = 'week'
  and starts >= date_trunc('week', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone 'UTC')::date
  and starts <= $__timeTo()::date
order by 1

panels.title: Active accounts per month
panels.description: Accounts that opened their deliveries, on the web or the iPhone each UTC month. Earlier periods count sign-ins and session renewals instead, from before openings were recorded.

targets.rawSql:
select (starts::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time, accounts as "Active accounts"
from metrics.active_accounts
where period = 'month'
  and starts >= date_trunc('month', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz at time zone 'UTC')::date
  and starts <= $__timeTo()::date
order by 1

panels.title: Lookups opened again later
panels.description: Lookups made each UTC day of the last 30, by whether their link was opened again on a later day: the guest coming back, or someone they shared it with. A lookup kept in an account since leaves the count, and the latest days have had less time to come back.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  opened_later as "Opened again on a later day",
  lookups - opened_later as "Not opened again"
from metrics.lookup_returns
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

matcher.options: Opened again on a later day

panels.title: New accounts from a lookup
panels.description: Accounts made each UTC day, by whether they kept a lookup made before the account: a guest who signed in. One whose kept link was deleted since, with its parcel, no longer counts.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  from_lookup as "Kept a lookup made before",
  accounts - from_lookup as "Other"
from metrics.lookup_accounts
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Devices with alerts on links
panels.description: Devices with an alert on a parcel link now, without an account, by whether they follow one parcel or several. Alerts end once the parcel is delivered.

targets.rawSql:
select case kind when 'web' then 'Web' when 'iphone' then 'iPhone' else 'Android' end as device,
  devices - following_several as "One parcel",
  following_several as "Two or more"
from metrics.link_alert_devices
order by array_position(array['web', 'iphone', 'android'], link_alert_devices.kind)

panels.title: Lookups by proof, daily
panels.description: Lookups without an account each day, from Prometheus, by what let them through: app_attest is the iPhone app, key_attestation and play_integrity the Android app, turnstile the web; refused were stopped. The counters restart with each deploy.

panels.title: Lookups kept in an account, daily
panels.description: Lookups kept in an account each day, from Prometheus: kept, already in the account, refused over its quota, or no longer there. The counters restart with each deploy.

panels.title: Guest networks per day
panels.description: Networks (hashed addresses) that made a lookup without an account, from Prometheus. Each day's bar counts the day before (UTC); a household or an office counts once, a phone moving between networks more than once.

panels.title: Installs seen per day
panels.description: Apps and browsers that sent their counting id each UTC day, as what each first was that day: new (first seen, without an account), returning (seen before, without an account) or signed in. A reinstall or cleared storage counts as new.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  sum(installs) filter (where kind = 'new') as "New guest",
  sum(installs) filter (where kind = 'returning') as "Returning guest",
  sum(installs) filter (where kind = 'account') as "Signed in"
from metrics.installs_daily
where $__timeFilter(day) and kind <> 'converted'
group by day
order by 1

panels.title: Guests by week first seen
panels.description: Installs first seen without an account in each of the last 12 weeks: seen on one day only (shown two weeks after the week starts), seen again on a later day, or signed in since.

targets.rawSql:
select (week::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  one_day as "One day only",
  came_back as "Came back",
  signed_in as "Signed in since"
from metrics.guest_cohorts
where $__timeFilter(week)
order by 1

panels.title: Active installs, 7 days
panels.description: Apps and browsers seen in the last 7 UTC days, by platform: those never seen signed in, and the others.

targets.rawSql:
select case platform when 'web' then 'Web' when 'pwa' then 'Web app' when 'iphone' then 'iPhone' when 'ipad' then 'iPad' when 'mac' then 'Mac' else 'Android' end as platform,
  guests_week as "Guest",
  week - guests_week as "Signed in"
from metrics.active_installs
order by array_position(array['web', 'pwa', 'iphone', 'ipad', 'mac', 'android'], active_installs.platform)

panels.title: Parcels being tracked
panels.description: Parcels neither delivered, returned nor archived at the end of each UTC day. Days from before the counts were kept are rebuilt from the parcels stored now.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  parcels_open_account as "With an account",
  parcels_open_lookup as "Without an account"
from metrics.daily
where parcels_open_account is not null and $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Parcels added per day
panels.description: Parcels added to an account (kept lookups included) or looked up without one, each UTC day.

targets.rawSql:
select (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
  parcels_added_account as "With an account",
  parcels_added_lookup as "Without an account"
from metrics.daily
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Parcels, all time
panels.description: Running total of the parcels added, to the end of each UTC day.

targets.rawSql:
select time, "With an account", "Without an account"
from (
  select day, (day::timestamp at time zone 'UTC') as time,
    sum(parcels_added_account) over (order by day) as "With an account",
    sum(parcels_added_lookup) over (order by day) as "Without an account"
  from metrics.daily
) as total
where $__timeFilter(day)
order by 1

panels.title: Being tracked, by stage
panels.description: Parcels being tracked now, with or without an account, by their stage.

targets.rawSql:
select case stage
    when 'pending' then 'Added to tracking'
    when 'registered' then 'Label created'
    when 'accepted' then 'Received by carrier'
    when 'in_transit' then 'In transit'
    when 'customs' then 'At customs'
    when 'exception' then 'Needs attention'
    when 'out_for_delivery' then 'Out for delivery'
    when 'failed_attempt' then 'Delivery attempted'
    when 'ready_for_pickup' then 'Ready for pickup'
    else stage end as stage,
  account + lookup as parcels
from metrics.open_parcels
order by array_position(array['pending', 'registered', 'accepted', 'in_transit', 'customs',
  'exception', 'out_for_delivery', 'failed_attempt', 'ready_for_pickup'], open_parcels.stage)

panels.title: Carriers
panels.description: Carriers of the parcels added in the time range that are still stored.

targets.rawSql:
select carrier, sum(parcels) as parcels
from metrics.carriers
where $__timeFilter(day)
group by carrier
order by parcels desc, carrier
limit 12

panels.title: Web push
panels.description: Accounts with web push switched on in at least one browser.

targets.rawSql: select web_push_accounts from metrics.live

panels.title: iPhone notifications
panels.description: Accounts with notifications switched on on at least one iPhone.

targets.rawSql: select iphone_push_accounts from metrics.live

panels.title: Android notifications
panels.description: Accounts with notifications switched on on at least one Android phone.

targets.rawSql: select android_push_accounts from metrics.live

panels.title: Delivery emails
panels.description: Accounts that get an email when a parcel is delivered.

targets.rawSql: select email_accounts from metrics.live

panels.title: Alerts on links
panels.description: Alerts readers of a parcel link turned on, without an account.

targets.rawSql: select link_alerts from metrics.live
